The diagnostic summary reports pairs_tested 1 and status COMPLETE but anomalies_tested 0 and episodes_reported 0 — not evidence of stability. The error source is COMPLETE with cap_exceeded false, transport "manual", request_count 0 and query `import` SUCCESS. No load-generator resource series is among the seven bound series, so generator-side saturation can be neither confirmed nor excluded.

No load-generator resource series or generator guard is present among the seven bound series, so generator-side saturation can be neither confirmed nor excluded.

Counts and denominators differ by scope and window (overall 75411 samples / throughput denominator 720000 versus window 73813 / 705000); these measure different spans and are not evidence of inconsistent data.

All epoch values quoted are absolute millisecond timestamps from the evidence; the durations and spacings mentioned here (for example the 720000 ms run span, the 705000 ms evaluation span, the 240000 ms burst spacing, and the 4232 ms / 10768 ms dropped cells) are differences computed from those fields, not durations reported by a single field.

throughput_rps is given only as numerator/denominator pairs (75411000/720000 overall, 73813000/705000 in window) without an explicit unit statement in the evidence, so the ratio should be quoted as stored rather than converted.

The percentile-based inference about fast failures assumes failed samples are included in the reported latency percentiles; the evidence does not state this, so it remains a hypothesis pending row-level JTL inspection.

Only operator-performable actions are recommended (rerun, inspect data, configure a policy, verify clocks). No causal conclusion is asserted, and the equality of the counts 3688 across overall, checkout and error-store scopes has not been verified as the same underlying events.
